links.comparator_used: Contemporaneous sites B-D using a SIRS-based sepsis alert without a sepsis navigator, and historical site A data before implementation
links.outcome: Time to initial antimicrobial delivery from ED arrival (and from threshold score to antimicrobial)
links.effect: Site A 3.33 h (IQR 2.10-5.37) vs sites B-D 3.22 h (IQR 1.97-5.60; p = 0.437); site A historical 6.20 h (IQR 3.49-11.61; p < 0.001). After matching-weight adjustment, no difference between contemporaneous sites; adjusted time improved by 2.87 h (p < 0.001) vs site A historical.
links.quote: Adjusted time to initial antimicrobial improved by 2.87 h (p < 0.001) at site A compared with site A historical.

design_hint: Sepsis alert with electronic navigator workflow versus SIRS-based alert
